name: lifeworkgps.tech compass
summary: The lifeworkgps.tech switchboard: a compass that routes people to Explore, Mentor, Outfitters, Careers and VetNav. Signed out, every link opens its public page; signed in, the hub's navigation sends each link to the signed-in destination.

identity.current.notes: Header sign-in, signed-in name and initials, sign out. Until wired, the existing Sign in link stays exactly as it is.

endpoint.navigation.notes: Signed-in destination per data-dest key: explore, mentor, mentor.get-coaching, mentor.become-a-coach, outfitters, outfitters.provider, careers, careers.employer, vetnav, vetnav.provider.
